name: Rider-Waite-Smith Tarot
market_role: Most influential modern reading grammar; default reference for many contemporary decks.
semantic_lesson: Minor arcana can carry story, posture, weather, and spatial relation rather than only suit pips.
variation_lesson: Extract actor, prop, gesture, threshold, weather, number, and relationship atoms; do not copy the scene.

name: Tarot de Marseille
market_role: Important historic pattern; useful for symbolic simplification and suit-pip logic.
semantic_lesson: A card can be readable through rank, suit, icon, and layout even without full narrative scenes.
variation_lesson: Use repetition, limited palette, and emblematic shape to create meaning without illustration overload.
product_lesson: Good for advanced readers and collectors who value historical structure.

name: Crowley Thoth Tarot
market_role: Advanced occult deck known for dense correspondences and visionary abstraction.
semantic_lesson: Deep systems can encode a card through correspondence networks, not only literal illustration.
variation_lesson: Only use correspondence logic when our own ontology explicitly supports it; avoid random occult decoration.
product_lesson: Depth attracts advanced users but increases interpretation burden.

name: Morgan-Greer Tarot
market_role: Readable classic deck route with more saturated, emotionally direct imagery.
semantic_lesson: Cropping and color intensity can make classic meanings feel immediate without changing the root system.
variation_lesson: Use framing as semantic emphasis; a crop can intensify a card without adding new symbols.
product_lesson: Useful reference for making traditional decks feel vivid and accessible.

name: The Wild Unknown Tarot
market_role: Mass-market independent-to-publisher success showing non-human symbolism can still read as tarot.
semantic_lesson: Human figures are not required if animal/nature symbols preserve the archetypal relation.
variation_lesson: Translate human drama into natural metaphor only when the replacement keeps the same relational geometry.
product_lesson: A coherent world can become a strong deck identity.

name: Modern Witch Tarot
market_role: Shows that market-friendly variation can modernize bodies, clothing, tools, and social context while preserving RWS readability.
semantic_lesson: A deck can keep traditional symbolic grammar while moving the social world into the present.
variation_lesson: Modernization must serve card meaning, not become generic lifestyle illustration.
product_lesson: Representation and immediate recognizability can both be selling points.

name: The Light Seer's Tarot
market_role: Modern deck route centered on relatable characters, light/shadow psychology, and intuitive self-work.
semantic_lesson: A market deck can foreground psychological accessibility while still reimagining traditional archetypes.
variation_lesson: Emotional tone and shadow work can become explicit generation controls.
product_lesson: Approachable depth matters for users who want self-reflection rather than occult study.
